case_title: SRINIVAS GUNDLURI & ORS. v. MIS. SEPCO ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION CORPORATION & ORS.
accused_occupation: Managing Director and Principal Officer of SSVG Engineering Projects Pvt. Ltd.
neutral_facts: The case involves a dispute between SEPCO Electric Power Construction Corporation and SSVG Engineering Projects Pvt. Ltd. regarding a works contract for the erection of a power plant. SEPCO alleged that SSVG misappropriated advance money provided under the contract. SEPCO filed a criminal complaint against SSVG under various sections of the Indian Penal Code. The Magistrate directed police investigation under Section 156(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The police initiated an investigation, and the Managing Director of SSVG was taken into custody. The High Court upheld the Magistrate's order, and the Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, finding no illegality in the Magistrate's decision to direct police investigation. The case was remanded for further proceedings.
